items.name: profile-card
items.title: Profile Card
items.description: Profile header, stats and a tabbed feed — a gliding tab underline and a Follow button that quiets down once pressed.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A bundle read as a tree: folders fold open under the pointer or the arrow keys, one highlight glides between rows, and a quiet right-hand column says how much each file holds.

items.name: coverflow-rail
items.title: Coverflow Rail
items.description: A cover rail you throw with a finger — the centre card faces you square, neighbours rake away and sink back, and a flick carries at most two cards before it settles.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible accordion sidebar with icon'd sections, an active rail, and socials.

items.name: macos-dock
items.title: macOS Dock
items.description: macOS-style magnifying dock — cursor-driven icon springs, click bounce, floor reflections, running-app dots, and a ⌘K command menu.

items.name: browser-window
items.title: Browser Window
items.description: Chrome / Safari mock window frame for screenshots and embeds.

items.name: macbook-frame
items.title: MacBook Frame
items.description: Front-facing MacBook mockup — drop a screenshot, gradient, or live UI on the screen.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: Draggable stacked-card carousel — swipe or drag the top card, click to expand into a details modal with a floating dock.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: Responsive grid of project cards with hover-reveal actions and a shared details modal.

items.name: card-list
items.title: Card List
items.description: Vertical list of horizontal project cards with media, copy, and a shared details modal.

items.name: bento-gallery
items.title: Bento Gallery
items.description: Draggable bento grid of media that expands into a shared lightbox modal with a floating dock switcher.

items.name: cutout-card
items.title: Cutout Card
items.description: Media card with a scooped-out content tray (concave corners), hover-reveal action button, and gradient overlay.

items.name: gradient-button-group
items.title: Gradient Button Group
items.description: Segmented icon switcher with a sliding gradient selection pill driven by a shared layout animation.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expanding accordion rows — each reveals its body, a checklist, and a visual.

items.name: project-card
items.title: Project Card
items.description: Shared cutout project card with blurred-gradient media and a liquid-metal hover ring.

items.name: historical-eps
items.title: Historical EPS
items.description: Forecast-vs-reported quarterly bars — dashed forecasts, a derived Beat-by tip, and a surprise tooltip.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price Target Fan
items.description: Analyst targets — history walks to now, dashed projections fan to High / Mean / Low with a scrub-following KPI card.

items.name: market-watchlist
items.title: Market Watchlist
items.description: Sortable quote register — trend sparklines, signed day changes, accent spine on the selected row.

items.name: sma-chart
items.title: SMA Chart
items.description: Moving-average chart — price line with fast/slow SMA overlays, crosshair scrubbing with a three-series tooltip, and a signed change chip.

items.name: market-snapshot
items.title: Market Snapshot
items.description: Price snapshot card — animated headline price, period-sliced line chart with crosshair scrubbing, and a gliding period switcher.

items.name: index-card
items.title: Index Card
items.description: Markets sidebar card — one big price over a full-bleed scrubbable line, a tab underline that walks between indices, and the one-paragraph read below.

items.name: range-navigator
items.title: Range Navigator
items.description: Focus + context price history — a detail chart over a mini-map you drag to pan and pull to zoom, with a hover crosshair reading price and date.

items.name: sectors-donut
items.title: Sectors Donut
items.description: Allocation ring with legend cross-highlight — hovering isolates one weight at a time.

items.name: ratings-radar
items.title: Ratings Radar
items.description: Analyst-ratings pentagon with hairline rings and one green wedge toward the dominant rating.

items.name: analyst-radar
items.title: Analyst Radar
items.description: Two-series factor radar — subject filled against a dashed peer outline, a hovered spoke reading both values, and a legend that mutes a series.

items.name: kpi-card-row
items.title: KPI Card Row
items.description: Dashboard stat band — count-up headlines with signed deltas over full-bleed area charts you can hover to read any sample with its date.

items.name: heat-calendar
items.title: Heat Calendar
items.description: Weeks of activity as a sequential single-hue grid with per-cell hover counts.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns Calendar
items.description: Monthly-returns heat grid — years × months diverging up/down by magnitude, a compounded year-total column, and a hover read-out that dims everything unrelated.

items.name: holdings-table
items.title: Holdings Table
items.description: Fund-holdings register with YTD pills and tick-comb weight bars.

items.name: trade-journal-table
items.title: Trade Journal Table
items.description: A trade log where the open position is lit from its spine and every closed one settles into a win or loss pill; heads sort, the range thumb slides, net P&L carries its fee formula.

items.name: fills-blotter
items.title: Fills Blotter
items.description: A streaming order-fills table: new fills slide in at the top as working, then resolve in place to filled or rejected; hover a row for venue, order id and fee; pausable.

items.name: matrix-ticker-board
items.title: Matrix Ticker Board
items.description: A retro dot-matrix price wall on canvas: 5×7 dot glyphs, and on each quote update only the changed characters dissolve out dot by dot and bloom back.

items.name: request-log
items.title: Request Log
items.description: API log rows with status pills that unfold their response body inline.

items.name: new-items-pill
items.title: New Items Pill
items.description: A live tape that pins the row you are reading — arrivals stop pushing the list down and count into a pill until you tap back to the top.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: Notification inbox — unread dots dissolve on read, mark-all clears the column.

items.name: project-index
items.title: Project Index
items.description: Bare project rows where the cover only exists while you hover, floating beside the cursor.

items.name: news-card
items.title: News Card
items.description: Auto-cycling news module with an ink headline and dot pagination.

items.name: alert-stack
items.title: Alert Stack
items.description: Collapsed notification deck that fans open on hover; each dismiss re-settles the pile.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: Setup checklist — the check draws in and the progress bar keeps a derivable score.

items.name: preferences-card
items.title: Preferences Card
items.description: Settings rows with icon tiles, one-line hints, and a chevron that walks in on hover.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A dotted field, a hairline icon chip, one line of ink and one quiet action.

items.name: swap-ticket
items.title: Swap Ticket
items.description: Composed trade card. A flip button on the seam really swaps the cards, a token-select overlay covers the ticket, and the CTA label is the validation state.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Hairline pill whose thumb glides between options with a shared-layout spring.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping gradient-orb coins with a surface ring. Hovering lifts and names a coin, and the overflow count floats the hidden names without widening the stack.

items.name: amount
items.title: Amount
items.description: Money-formatting family — Fiat, Crypto and Percent agree on symbol placement, precision, abbreviation and sign colouring.

items.name: crypto-fiat
items.title: Crypto/Fiat
items.description: Dual-denomination amount field. Type in fiat or units, the toggle carries the value through the rate, and the headline steps down a size tier as it grows.

items.name: screen-shuffle
items.title: Screen Shuffle
items.description: Stacked screens where the front card arcs to the back on a timer or click.

items.name: mouse-trail-cta
items.title: Mouse-Trail CTA
items.description: CTA stage where the cursor's particle trail gravitates into the pill and feeds its glow.

items.name: ascii-turntable
items.title: ASCII Turntable
items.description: An extruded solid that turns with the cursor and is redrawn as characters on a grid. The lighting is graded for the ramp, so the face lands mid-scale instead of saturating to one glyph.

items.name: simple-landing
items.title: Developer Tools Landing (paid screen)
items.description: The library's own marketing page: a near-black ground, one object per section, two-tone display type carrying the hierarchy, and every count read live from the registry.
